input.command:
scripts/quest-runner issues create --scope polishing --slice 4 --title "Streaming cursor and reasoning spinner persist after stream end" --description "In RenderTranscript (projects/web/src/agui-chat.js:1120-1127), an already-created message node is only re-rendered when 'message.isStreaming || state.openTextMessages.has(id) || state.openReasoning.has(id) || message.role === tool'. For assistant and reasoning messages, the terminal streaming->not-streaming transition is therefore never rendered: TEXT_MESSAGE_END sets message.isStreaming=false and removes the id from openTextMessages, and REASONING_MESSAGE_END/REASONING_END do the same for openReasoning. When the END event arrives in a LATER animation frame than the last content delta (the normal streaming case, since deltas and END arrive in separate WebSocket batches), the node-update gate evaluates false and UpdateMessageNode is skipped.

Consequences:
- Assistant bubbles keep the agui-chat-streaming blinking cursor (added in UpdateAssistantContent, agui-chat.js:1001-1003) permanently after the message finishes streaming.
- Reasoning panels keep their spinner visible forever, since UpdateMessageNode only hides the reasoning spinner (agui-chat.js:1040-1046) when the node is re-rendered, which never happens after END.

This contradicts the slice spec/plan: assistant should add a blinking cursor element while isStreaming (implying removal when not streaming) and reasoning should show a spinner while streaming only. Tool messages are unaffected because role==='tool' is always in the update gate.

Test gap: existing renderer tests do not cover this. 'text streaming reuses the same message DOM node' never sends TEXT_MESSAGE_END in a separate render pass, and 'tool and reasoning panels toggle expanded state' sends START+CONTENT+END in a single applyServerMessage followed by one renderChat, so the node is created fresh with isStreaming already false and the cross-frame transition is never exercised.

To close: after a streaming assistant or reasoning message ends in a render pass separate from its last content delta, the rendered DOM must no longer contain the agui-chat-streaming cursor (assistant) or a visible spinner (reasoning), and a regression test must cover the separate-frame END transition for both roles."
